description:
ABOUT LIQUID AI

Spun out of MIT CSAIL, we build general-purpose AI systems that run efficiently across deployment targets, from data center accelerators to on-device hardware, ensuring low latency, minimal memory usage, privacy, and reliability. We partner with enterprises across consumer electronics, automotive, life sciences, and financial services. We are scaling rapidly and need exceptional people to help us get there.




THE OPPORTUNITY

Liquid Console and our API give developers and businesses access to Liquid’s models. We’re looking for a product engineer to improve the experience from a developer’s first sign-up and API request through reliable, ongoing production use.

You’ll work across customer-facing product experiences and the services behind them, taking problems from discovery through design, implementation and iteration. Working closely with engineering and go-to-market teams, you’ll turn customer feedback into improvements that make Liquid easier to adopt and use.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We need someone who:

 - You turn ambiguity into action. You can start with a customer problem, identify the important constraints, make a plan and deliver without waiting for a fully specified ticket.

 - You care about the whole product. You think beyond whether a feature works in isolation to how customers discover, integrate with and rely on it.

 - You balance speed and durability. You make pragmatic tradeoffs, ship iteratively and strengthen the systems that customers depend on.




THE WORK

 - Build and improve the Console and APIs developers use to access and integrate Liquid’s models.

 - Own customer-facing workflows end to end, from onboarding and API access to ongoing usage and account management.

 - Improve experiences around usage, credits and billing, connecting clear product interfaces to reliable backend services.

 - Make the platform easier to understand and operate, including how customers encounter limits, errors and other service behavior.

 - Work directly with customers and internal partners to identify friction, prioritize opportunities and ship pragmatic solutions.

 - Use production signals and customer feedback to improve reliability and usability, and partner with inference engineers on issues that cross the product and model-serving stack.




DESIRED EXPERIENCE

What you'll need:

 - Experience building and shipping customer-facing software, including production APIs or services used by external developers or customers.

 - Ability to own meaningful projects end to end, from an ambiguous problem through a production outcome.

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience designing, debugging and operating reliable production systems.

 - Product judgment: you can understand user needs, weigh tradeoffs and make decisions that improve the overall experience.

 - Clear communication and the ability to work across engineering and customer-facing teams.

Helpful, not required:

 - Experience building developer-facing platforms, APIs or self-serve products.

 - Experience working across frontend and backend systems to deliver a complete product experience.

 - Familiarity with AI model APIs or inference, and the developer workflows around integrating them.

 - Experience working in a small team or early-stage product where requirements and priorities evolve quickly.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (YEAR ONE)

 - You’ve taken meaningful Console and API improvements from customer problem to production, making it easier for developers to get started and build with Liquid.

 - You’ve improved the reliability and usability of critical customer-facing workflows, addressing recurring friction and helping customers use the platform with confidence.

 - You independently identify and prioritize opportunities, working with customers and teammates to make sound product and technical decisions.

 - You’ve strengthened the team’s ability to ship and support the product through thoughtful design, collaboration and shared context.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Direct product impact: Help shape the Console and API that connect customers to Liquid’s models, with ownership from the first customer conversation through production.

 - Compensation & Equity: Competitive base salary plus equity, so you share in what we build. Final offers reflect skills, experience, and location.

 - Time Off: Unlimited PTO, plus company-wide Refill Days, long weekends when the whole company rests together.

 - Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive health coverage, with details varying by location.

 - Paid Leave: Paid leave for pregnancy, parenting, medical needs, and caring for family.
